Documented behavior and historical references

ILLUSTRATED BMW SEQUENCE

Sending and acknowledgement

BMW’s four-screen sequence shows confirmation, sending and successful transmission. Acknowledgement precedes a fresh vehicle status.

View source ↗
BMW SUPPORT GUIDANCE

Remote services unavailable

BMW describes stable connectivity and active data privacy settings as prerequisites. No exact error-dialog copy is established here.

View source ↗
BMW SUPPORT GUIDANCE

Stale vehicle status

Use the vehicle’s last update time when reporting its status. A stale value cannot confirm a new command.

View source ↗
BMW SUPPORT GUIDANCE

Insufficient energy

The documented departure preconditioning function requires a sufficiently charged battery. The guide does not give a universal threshold.

View source ↗
BMW SUPPORT GUIDANCE

Charging interruption

After an unexpected interruption, the vehicle attempts recovery. Restarting an AC session that the driver deliberately stopped has different conditions.

View source ↗
BMW CHARGING GUIDANCE

Plug & Charge authentication

BMW Charging documents alternative authentication through the app or charging card after a failed attempt.

View source ↗
BMW SUPPORT GUIDANCE

Engine start limits

BMW documents a two-start limit before an in-vehicle engine start for the described feature.
